theorems.name: Submission.chartTD_chart_fderiv_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (B : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (K : ℝ≥0) (c : ℝ), IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ B → LipschitzOnWith K ψ B → (∀ u ∈ B, ∀ u' ∈ B, c * ‖u - u'‖ ≤ ‖ψ u - ψ u'‖) → ∀ v ∈ B, ‖fderiv ℝ ψ v‖ ≤ K ∧ ∀ w : Rn n, c * ‖w‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ ψ v w‖
